title: Ansel and the Contact
author: I. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Yara Ravensworth, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
